content: No published formula combines RPE + duration + load specifically for loaded carries/sleds. The closest validated model is Foster's session-RPE (load = duration_min * RPE, 1-10 CR10 scale), the standard 'internal load' method for training load monitoring across modalities. Practical carry-load conventions: recreational lifters carry ~0.5x BW per hand, elite ~1x-3x BW total load; sled push is commonly loaded near ~1x BW. These support D-20's proposed shape (durationMin * (RPE/10)^2 * k, IF^2-style, plus a load/bodyweight ratio multiplier) as a reasonable engine-consistent extrapolation, but the exact k must be fit via a golden test (per D-20) since no external literature provides one.
